description: Get all accounts with their labels and categories for this tenant. Filter by the 'category' field, NOT account numbers. Use the system prompt's tenant-specific category lists to identify revenue vs. cost accounts. Ignore: 'Bank', 'Cash', 'VAT'. Optional filters: exact category, account number range (account_from/account_to), and is_pnl (P&L vs. balance sheet accounts). Omit 'limit' to get every matching account (paginated internally, no row cap); pass it only to cap the number of rows returned — the response then reports whether the result was truncated.

is_pnl.description: Filter by P&L accounts (true) or balance sheet accounts (false)

limit.description: Optional cap on the number of accounts returned (must be a positive integer). Omit to get the full, unpaginated-by-you list of every matching account. When set, the query itself is bounded (no full-table load) and the response's 'truncated' field tells you whether more accounts existed beyond the cap.

name: get_all_accounts
